description: A 40 x 40 m riparian crop of the StREAM Lab drone survey, decimated 1:160 from ~1295 to ~8 pts/m2 (deterministic filters.decimation, so the crop is reproducible). Survey-classified: ground, high vegetation and unclassified all present, so it carries real above-ground truth the White Sands desert lacks.
binLayout: n=16791: [xyz Float32 n*3][rgb Uint16 n*3][returnNumber Uint8 n][numberOfReturns Uint8 n][classification Uint8 n]; xyz relative to origin (add originH1/H2 to x/y)
